items.translation: `Component.value()` 的别名。

items.source: Classes annotated with @ControllerAdvice can be declared explicitly as Spring beans or auto-detected via classpath scanning. All such beans are sorted based on Ordered semantics or @Order / @Priority declarations, with Ordered semantics taking precedence over @Order / @Priority declarations. @ControllerAdvice beans are then applied in that order at runtime. Note, however, that @ControllerAdvice beans that implement PriorityOrdered are not given priority over @ControllerAdvice beans that implement Ordered. In addition, Ordered is not honored for scoped @ControllerAdvice beans — for example if such a bean has been configured as a request-scoped or session-scoped bean. For handling exceptions, an @ExceptionHandler will be picked on the first advice with a matching exception handler method. For model attributes and data binding initialization, @ModelAttribute and @InitBinder methods will follow @ControllerAdvice order.
items.translation: 使用 `@ControllerAdvice` 注解标注的类可以显式声明为 Spring Bean，也可以通过类路径扫描自动检测。所有这些 Bean 均根据 `Ordered` 语义或 @Order / @Priority 声明进行排序，其中 `Ordered` 语义优先于 `@Order` / `@Priority` 声明。运行时将按此顺序应用这些 `@ControllerAdvice` Bean。但请注意，实现 PriorityOrdered 的 `@ControllerAdvice` Bean 不会 获得相对于实现 `Ordered` 的 `@ControllerAdvice` Bean 的优先级。此外，对于作用域为请求级或会话级的 `@ControllerAdvice` Bean（例如配置为请求级或会话级 Bean），其 `Ordered` 语义不会被遵循。在处理异常时，将选择第一个具有匹配异常处理方法的建议中的 `@ExceptionHandler`。对于模型属性和数据绑定初始化，`@ModelAttribute` 和 @InitBinder 方法将遵循 `@ControllerAdvice` 的顺序。

items.source: By default, the methods in an @ControllerAdvice apply globally to all controllers. Use selectors such as annotations(), basePackageClasses(), and basePackages() (or its alias value()) to define a more narrow subset of targeted controllers. If multiple selectors are declared, boolean OR logic is applied, meaning selected controllers should match at least one selector. Note that selector checks are performed at runtime, so adding many selectors may negatively impact performance and add complexity.
items.translation: 默认情况下，@ControllerAdvice 中的方法全局适用于所有控制器。使用诸如 annotations()、basePackageClasses() 和 basePackages()（或其别名 value()）等选择器来定义更窄的目标控制器子集。如果声明了多个选择器，将应用布尔 OR 逻辑，这意味着所选控制器必须至少匹配一个选择器。请注意，选择器检查是在运行时执行的，因此添加过多选择器可能会对性能产生负面影响并增加复杂性。

items.source: Allows for more concise annotation declarations — for example, @ControllerAdvice("org.my.pkg") is equivalent to @ControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg").
items.translation: 允许使用更简洁的注解声明——例如，`@ControllerAdvice("org.my.pkg")` 等价于 `@ControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Controllers that belong to those base packages or sub-packages thereof will be included — for example, @ControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg") or @ControllerAdvice(basePackages = {"org.my.pkg", "org.my.other.pkg"}).
items.translation: 属于这些基础包或其子包的控制器将被包含在内——例如， @ControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg") 或 @ControllerAdvice(basePackages = {"org.my.pkg", "org.my.other.pkg"})。

items.source: value() is an alias for this attribute, simply allowing for more concise use of the annotation.
items.translation: value() 是该属性的别名，仅允许更简洁地使用此注解。

items.source: Also consider using basePackageClasses() as a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 此外，还可以考虑使用 `basePackageClasses()` 作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Consider creating a custom composed annotation or use a predefined one, like @RestController.
items.translation: 考虑创建自定义组合注解或使用预定义的注解，例如@RestController。

items.source: Note: For @ExceptionHandler methods, a root exception match will be preferred to just matching a cause of the current exception, among the handler methods of a particular advice bean. However, a cause match on a higher-priority advice will still be preferred over any match (whether root or cause level) on a lower-priority advice bean. As a consequence, please declare your primary root exception mappings on a prioritized advice bean with a corresponding order.
items.translation: 注意：对于 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法，在特定建议（advice）bean 的处理方法中，根异常匹配将优先于仅匹配当前异常的成因。然而，更高优先级建议中的成因匹配仍将优于任何较低优先级建议 bean 中的匹配（无论是根级别还是成因级别）。因此，请在具有相应顺序的已排序建议 bean 上声明您的主要根异常映射。

items.source: Controllers that are assignable to at least one of the given types will be advised by the @ControllerAdvice annotated class.
items.translation: 可以被分配给给定类型之一的控制器将由带有 `@ControllerAdvice` 注解的类进行增强。

items.source: Controllers that are annotated with at least one of the supplied annotation types will be advised by the @ControllerAdvice annotated class.
items.translation: 由至少一个提供的注解类型标注的控制器将由带有 `@ControllerAdvice` 注解的类进行增强。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages in which to select controllers to be advised by the @ControllerAdvice annotated class.
items.translation: 用于指定要由 `@ControllerAdvice` 注解的类建议的控制器所在的包的 `basePackages()` 的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute.
items.translation: ``basePackages()` 属性的别名。

that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。
